mapper.select: SELECT a.item_id , b.page_id , a.section_id , b.page_nm , b.page_key , b.url , b.icon , a.sort_no , '0' AS hidden FROM CLOVER_NAV_ITEM a , CLOVER_PAGE b WHERE a.nav_id = #{value} AND a.page_id = b.page_id ORDER BY a.sort_no, a.item_id

SELECT a.section_id , a.section_nm , a.icon , a.up_section_id FROM CLOVER_PAGE_SECTION a , ( SELECT k.section_id FROM CLOVER_NAV_ITEM k WHERE k.nav_id = #{value} GROUP BY k.section_id ) b WHERE a.section_id = b.section_id
